title: Aphelion selected downloads and Auth logging checkpoint
content:
Tonight's Aphelion/Auth pass turned selected-image download into a real signed-in workflow instead of a loose prototype edge case. The visible change is small on the page, but the structure behind it matters: selection, download, account state, and audit history now line up more cleanly.

What changed:

  • Selected-page controls: Aphelion's selected view now includes Select all, Deselect all, and Download (n), so larger download sessions no longer require one-by-one checkbox cleanup.
  • Detailed local manifest: every selected-image zip download now writes a local JSONL log entry inside Aphelion with the timestamp, account name, item count, and exact downloaded items.
  • Auth activity bridge: Auth now records a higher-level aphelion.selected_zip_downloaded event, keeping the central timeline aware that a download happened without stuffing the full manifest into the shared notification surface.
  • Smoother signed-in handoff: the popup sign-in gate was loosened so Auth admins can complete the Aphelion handoff and use signed-in public tools even before the owner-only admin/options surface is reopened to them.

The key logic here is separation of layers: Auth should know that an important cross-app action happened, while Aphelion itself should keep the exact downloaded set. That gives us both accountability and clarity without overloading the central activity stream.
